auditor.independence_note: Different agent and different model from the translator (i18n-translator / anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5). This pass did not read any earlier audit comment, receipt or ledger row for zh-CN; it re-derived every judgement from the English source, the English context sidecars, the zh-CN style guide, the glossary and the head bytes.

findings.problem: A full causative clause (因…而…, written/书面 register) where the sibling turn-completion markers are terse state words: 已中断 for ui.chat.canonical.notice.interrupted in this same catalogue and 已停止 at ui.chat.action.stopped. Meaning, polarity, neutrality and width are all correct; this is phrasing polish only.
findings.evidence: en sidecar tone is 'neutral factual statement, sentence case, no trailing punctuation'; zh-CN style guide 'Terse: four-to-eight character lines where possible'. Suggested value is 12 cells, identical to the current one (en is 20 cells), so there is no width cost.
findings.disposition: open (polish; not a defect in meaning)

observations.note: 上下文压缩 = glossary §2 (zh-CN '压缩 (上下文压缩)') and shipped precedent src/i18n/catalogues/zh-CN/ui.settings.imports.session_meta ('#次上下文压缩'). Full-width colon ： mirrors the shipped detail-inserting precedent zh-CN ui.common.updates.update_notification.error_downloading_update ('下载更新出错：{detail}'); {detail} stays final and verbatim, as the sidecar requires.

—— is U+2014 U+2014, the mainland 破折号 (zh-CN style guide 'Punctuation & typography'; no U+2015/U+2013 in any of the three files). The dash form is right for a reason that already carries an ASCII colon, and no space is inserted before {detail}.

已中断 matches the shipped sibling zh-CN ui.chat.canonical.transcript.interrupted byte-for-byte, which is correct because English uses the same word on both surfaces; the two keys' different roles are carried by ink and position, not by wording.

'{name}的操作' follows the shipped possessive+noun pattern zh-CN ui.teamBridge.row.menu ('{name}的更多操作'), obeys the no-space-between-CJK-and-Latin rule, and keeps {name} first (allowed: only the argument's name/type is frozen, not its order). Accepted.

Classifier 个 is correct for chats: zh-CN style guide plurals ('个 default; 条 for messages') and shipped precedent zh-CN ui.chat.sidebar.groups.badge ('此分组中有{badge}个对话'). The audited delta 条 -> 个 is a correction, not a regression. 全部…标为已读 follows zh-CN ui.notifications.action.mark_all_read ('全部标为已读').

Out of the translator's scope, recorded for the record: the en sidecar for this key has no width hint even though sibling group headings in the same list carry maxCells 24 (ui.chat.sidebar_view.time_section / tag / agent_team) and this sidecar uses maxCells 6/20/24/64 elsewhere. The target value 未分组 is 6 cells, far under the 24-cell family budget, so there is no fit risk here; the gap is an English-sidecar completeness note, not a target-copy defect.

verified: git show <head>:<path> byte reads for all nine files (en, en .context.json, zh-CN per namespace); worktree tree is clean for src/i18n/catalogues (git status empty), so worktree bytes == head bytes
sha256 over git show bytes (python3 hashlib) for each en / context / target file, recorded above
key-set parity per namespace at head: ui.chat.canonical 258/258, ui.chat.sidebar 81/81, ui.chat.sidebar_view 27/27 - zero missing, zero extra (the same rule ledger-assemble refuses on)
strict JSON parse plus duplicate-member scan (object_pairs_hook) on all six catalogues: no duplicates, all valid JSON

ICU parse of en and zh-CN values with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser 3.5.21 from the existing node_modules: argument names and types identical for every key; the number element keeps the ::group-off skeleton (parsedOptions.useGrouping === false) in both locales; no plural/select branch added in zh-CN (zh-CN needs `other` only, and none of the seven keys is a plural message)

byte checks: no Cf (bidi) characters in any of the seven zh-CN values; no ASCII , . : ; ! ? ( ) " ' in the zh-CN prose; U+FF1A for the colon form; U+2014 U+2014 for the dash form; no trailing 。 (en has none); no space inserted between CJK and digits

cell-width estimate (CJK/full-width = 2, ASCII = 1): notice.interrupted 6 vs en 11; stopped_with_error 12 vs en 20; compaction_not_run 26 vs en 23; after_colon 26 vs en 24; actions_for 12+name vs en 12+name; ungrouped 6 vs en 9; mark_all_read 14+digits vs en 14+digits. None of these 7 keys carries a maxCells/maxChars hint (their context entries hold role/tone/length/note/placeholders only; the sidebar_view sidecar does use maxCells 6/20/24/64 on other keys, and sibling group headings there budget 24 cells), so fit was judged against the English cell count and the sidebar-header constraint recorded in the context note
